description.en:
🔓 Free from cable and laptop failures
📶 Range over 30 meters with direct line of sight and over 50 meters without direct line of sight
🌍 Connect from anywhere in the world in internet mode
🔌 Supports RS232 and RS485
⚙️ Supports any device in MODBUS ASCII mode
💰 Reduces on-site support costs
🏭 The best choice for machine builders for remote support
🛡️ Stable, industrial-grade, and failure-free
⚡ Installation and setup in under a minute — easy and fast
🎛️ Simple and accessible configuration
